title: New Type IIB Poly-instanton Effects and Axion Quintessence
summary: Previous studies of poly-instantons in type IIB Calabi-Yau orientifolds found that these effects arise when Euclidean D3-branes wrap rigid cycles with a Wilson line. In this work, we extend this result through a general analysis of instanton zero modes, revealing the existence of new poly-instanton effects for rigid cycles with a deformation, provided that O3-planes are localised on the worldvolume of the Euclidean D3-brane.
